messages:
Nina P: Follow-up from the PM: we need a tight action plan for streaming timeouts/partials after last week's regression. Short thread, owners + dates.

Rob H: Quick summary of impact?

Nina P: ~1.9% sessions had >4s mid-stream silence, ~0.5% ended as truncated partials. Spike aligned with background eviction job during 01:00-01:45 UTC.

Lina M: Root cause looks like eviction interleaving with the flush loop -> brief stall. Clients often reconnect on perceived silence.

Nina P: Proposed actions (short):
- SDK: resume dedupe + backoff defaults (owner: Rob H) due 2026-03-26
- Observability: synthetic heartbeat + silence metric (owner: Lina M) due 2026-03-28
- Runtime: make eviction atomic relative to flush (owner: Nina P) due 2026-03-30

Rob H: SDK defaults suggestion:
```json
{"resumeDedupeMs":2500, "maxRetries":3, "baseBackoffMs":150}
```

Lina M: Synthetic will stream 45s and assert no >2.5s gap. Metric: telemetry.streaming.silence_pct. Alert: page SRE at >0.5% for 10m.

sre-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-501. Runbook linked.

Nina P: Canary plan: force eviction every 20s with 1k concurrent streams for 6m. Success if silence_pct <0.3. Schedule: maintenance window 2026-03-31.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting 2026-04-01 14:00 UTC.

Rob H: I'll draft SDK PR and make resume-dedupe opt-in for one release.

Lina M: Synthetic running in dev, dashboard link (dev): https://grafana.redwood/d/stream/silence-dev. Will promote to staging after a clean run.

Nina P: I'll coordinate the canary and update INC-2026-501. Post short status updates here. Thanks.

Rob H: PR created when ready, will link in ticket.

sre-bot: INC-2026-501 updated: Lina M added synthetic metric.

Nina P: Closing thread for now; reopen if blockers.
